name: Securities and Exchange Board of India — RSS feed
access: HTTPS GET to www.sebi.gov.in/sebirss.xml (RSS 2.0, <ttl>60</ttl>); no key

rate_limit.source: No request-rate policy found on https://www.sebi.gov.in/website-policy.html (2026-10-23). The feed declares <ttl>60</ttl> (minutes), so it is polled at most once an hour.

failure_behavior: Connection errors, 429 or 5xx: bounded exponential backoff, then the source's run is recorded FAILED; stored items remain with their first-seen times.
verdict_reason: SEBI's Website Policy: 'Material featured on this Website may be reproduced free of charge after taking proper permission by sending a mail to us.' No clause found that forbids reading the published RSS feed. Without that permission the feed is used only as a private feed reader: headline, link and date for the owner's own reading; nothing is reproduced, exported or redistributed.

datasets.description: SEBI orders, circulars, press releases and other updates (headline, link, publication date; the feed gives a date without a time)
datasets.coverage: SEBI web site updates (30 items on 2026-10-23)
datasets.availability_rule: first_seen receipt time; the feed's date is kept with day precision and never shown as a time
